cn.t: Critics hail Paulus's "Rhinoceros" as a stunning, darkly hilarious revival that feels urgently prescient. Turturro and Giamatti lead a stellar cast through Ionesco's absurdist classic, balancing gut-punch humor with chilling resonance.
